reference_use.conclusion: Snapshot project d09bc8a / Mathlib 25730c7c plus the pinned simongmt package. No match: Mathlib has no co-area formula (rg 'coarea': no file) and only a fixed-dimension Sard lemma (MeasureTheory/Function/Jacobian.lean), no C¹ Sard-type slice theorem and no countable rectifiability; SimonGMT has no nonlinear co-area formula. Hence the C¹ critical-slice estimate, the C¹ parametric co-area formula and the level-set rectifiability are supplied as children. Available and cited in the children: SimonGMT linear/projection co-area (CoareaLinear.lean, CoareaProjection.lean), Lipschitz and injective area formulas (AreaDomain.lean weighted_area_formula_lipschitzOn_fiberSum, injective_area_formula_lipschitzOn, ae_fderivWithin_eq_of_lipschitz_extension, exists_lipschitz_extension_finiteDimensional; WeightedArea.lean map_withDensity_areaJacobian_eq and weighted_area_formula_volume_of_injective_derivative for arbitrary integrands), Lipschitz image bound euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn, countablyRectifiable_image_contDiffOn_open / _iUnion / _of_measure_zero / CountablyRectifiable.mono, HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique (needs only θ x ≠ 0); Mathlib normDet (normDet_comp, normDet_of_subsingleton, normDet_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot, normDet_sq), μHE[d] = c_d·μH[d] with hausdorffMeasure_le_liminf_sum, EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume, inverse/implicit function theorem (ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph, OpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiffAt_symm, HasStrictFDerivAt.implicitToOpenPartialHomeomorph), change of variables lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul, Lusin-Souslin MeasurableSet.image_of_continuousOn_injOn / ContinuousOn.measurableEmbedding, lintegral_iUnion (arbitrary integrand), lintegral_tsum, lintegral_liminf_le, HasLineDerivAt.unique, Rademacher LipschitzWith.ae_differentiableAt, WithLp.volume_preserving_toLp. The README marks SimonGMT Chapter03 tangentialDifferential/tangentialJacobian (Differential.lean) as unfaithful; they are not used. subproblem.title: Pointwise identification of T_xM, d^Mf_x and the co-area Jacobian along a chart (Simon Ch. 3, 2.1-2.2, (2.7))
subproblem.statement: Let n, N, m ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, f : ℝ^N → ℝᵐ, x ∈ ℝ^N, and A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N, Γ : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ continuous linear maps such that θ(x) ≠ 0, A is injective, HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (range A), and f has line derivative Γw at x in direction Aw for every w ∈ ℝⁿ (HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (Γw) x (Aw)). Then (i) approxTangentPlane n M θ x = range A; (ii) there is a continuous linear L : range A → ℝᵐ with HasTangentialDifferentialAt (range A) f x L; (iii) coareaJacobian (approxTangentPlane n M θ x) f x · normDet(A) = normDet(A ∘ ι_{ker Γ})·normDet(Γ*). Notation (as in the parent): ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hˢ = μHE[s] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet; P* = LinearMap.adjoint P; DF(u) = fderiv ℝ F u.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n N m : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (Γ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m), θ x ≠ 0 → Function.Injective A → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) → (∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (Γ w) x (A w)) → approxTangentPlane n M θ x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap ∧ (∃ L : ↥(LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) →L[ℝ] Rn m, HasTangentialDifferentialAt (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) f x L) ∧ coareaJacobian (approxTangentPlane n M θ x) f x * A.toLinearMap.normDet = (A.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ.toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ.toLinearMap).normDet
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Part 1.2 (identification of T_xM and d^Mf_x through a chart, using uniqueness of weighted tangent planes and of line derivatives; Simon Ch. 3, 2.1-2.2 and (2.7), chapter-03.txt lines 335-360 and 412-418), combined with the sibling coarea_normDet_chain_rule (the parent's LA).
1. ((i).) Let T := range A. By definition, approxTangentPlane n M θ x = h.choose where h : ∃ P, HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P, which holds with P = T; and h.choose satisfies HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x h.choose (Exists.choose_spec). Since θ(x) ≠ 0, uniqueness of weighted approximate tangent spaces (SimonGMT HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique) gives h.choose = T.
2. ((ii).) A is injective, so it induces a linear isomorphism A' : ℝⁿ → T (LinearEquiv.ofInjective). Define L := Γ ∘ A'⁻¹ : T → ℝᵐ, continuous because T is finite-dimensional. For τ ∈ T put w := A'⁻¹τ, so τ = Aw and Lτ = Γw; the hypothesis gives HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (Lτ) x τ. Hence HasTangentialDifferentialAt T f x L.
3. (d^Mf_x = L.) By definition tangentialDifferential T f x = h'.choose for h' : ∃ L, HasTangentialDifferentialAt T f x L (true by step 2); call it L'. For each τ ∈ T both L'τ and Lτ are line derivatives of f at x in direction τ, so L'τ = Lτ by uniqueness of line derivatives (Mathlib HasLineDerivAt.unique). Hence tangentialDifferential T f x = L and coareaJacobian T f x = normDet((L as a linear map)*).
4. ((iii).) Rewrite approxTangentPlane n M θ x = T by step 1, so the left side is normDet(L*)·normDet(A) by step 3. For v ∈ ℝⁿ, L(Av) = Γ(A'⁻¹(Av)) = Γv. Apply the sibling coarea_normDet_chain_rule to T, the linear map A (injective, range A = T), L and Γ: normDet(L*)·normDet(A) = normDet(A ∘ ι_{ker Γ})·normDet(Γ*). ∎
proof_key_steps: Uniqueness of weighted approximate tangent spaces (θ(x) ≠ 0) identifies approxTangentPlane with range A.
L := Γ ∘ A'⁻¹ on range A is a tangential differential (line derivatives along A).
Uniqueness of line derivatives identifies tangentialDifferential with L.
The chain rule sibling converts coareaJacobian·normDet(A) into normDet(A∘ι_{ker Γ})·normDet(Γ*).

audit.reason: Weighted tangent uniqueness uses precisely θ(x) ≠ 0. The inverse of A onto its range constructs the tangential differential; line-derivative uniqueness identifies the chosen differential. The declared normDet child then proves the exact Jacobian identity.
